title: Broker Migration Spec
description: Input shape for scripts/broker_migration_audit.mjs — a normalized description of a coordination MCP's broker tool surface, its legacy-verb migration mapping, and the calling body's compliance mode.

brokerTools.description: The enforced broker's tool surface. Safe only when this is exactly the 5 canonical tools, no more, no fewer.

name.description: Tool name. Should be one of work/act/ask/recall/status; any other value is a broker-grew finding.

denialShape.description: True if this tool has exactly one documented denial shape for a rejected call.

transcriptEvent.description: True if this tool emits exactly one documented transcript event per call.

legacyVerbs.description: The full inventory of legacy etiquette verbs being retired. The documented collapse expects 19 entries.

name.description: Legacy verb name (e.g. begin_session, claim_port, sitrep).

mappedTo.description: The enforced tool this verb collapses into. null means unmapped — a critical finding.

migrationPath.description: How the legacy verb is being retired. "parallel-runtime" (or any value outside the other three) is forbidden — it means the old verb is still a live second code path.

complianceMode.description: The calling body's coordination compliance mode. C0-C3 are advisory and may keep the legacy surface; C4+ enforces the IT-018 Broker Collapse gate.

emitsLegacyVerbCalls.description: True if the body still makes any legacy-verb call at all. Must be false once complianceMode is C4 or above.
